entities.name: Ethyl 4-(2,2,2-trifluoroethyl)thiophene-2-carboxylate
observations: Reactant SELFIES decodes to CCOC(=O)c1csc(CC(F)(F)F)c1, containing an ethyl ester.
Sodium hydroxide hydrolyzes the ethyl ester; ethanol is the leaving-group product.

entities.name: 4-(2,2,2-Trifluoroethyl)thiophene-2-carboxylic acid
observations: The database-matched isolated product is O=C(O)c1csc(CC(F)(F)F)c1 after NaOH hydrolysis and aqueous workup.

entities.name: Sodium 4-(2,2,2-trifluoroethyl)thiophene-2-carboxylate
observations: The immediate species in basic medium is O=C([O-])c1csc(CC(F)(F)F)c1.[Na+].
This is the sodium carboxylate before acidic workup.

entities.name: NaOH hydrolysis of ethyl thiophene carboxylate
observations: Ethyl ester saponification converts C(=O)OCH2CH3 to the carboxylic acid after workup, or the sodium carboxylate under reaction conditions.
